title: Editors browse steering references and assignments

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Newsroom steering desk lists
  Scenario: Editor browses demo references by curation status
    Given I open the steering desk demo at 1280 by 900
    Then I should see the Shadcn steering app chrome
    And I should not see newspaper newsprint chrome
    When I open the steering References section
    Then I should see a pending reference
    And I should be able to filter references by accepted status
    When I open the steering Assignments section
    Then I should see a steering-relevant assignment

  Scenario: Signed-out live desk explains how to continue
    Given I open the live steering desk at 1280 by 900
    Then I should see a sign-in path for editor GraphQL
    And I should see a demo-mode link
